ata.title: Flight Compartment Wiring — Cockpit Panel Harnesses

abstract: Wiring sheet for the cockpit panel harnesses feeding the glareshield and centre panel controls, showing the harness runs, the connector list and the ground stud arrangement behind the panel.

sections.purpose: This sheet shows the cockpit panel harnesses that feed the glareshield and centre panel controls, with the connector references, the ground studs and the harness routes behind the panel.
sections.sheet_note: The sheet covers both sides of the centre panel; the glareshield runs are shown on the upper half and the centre panel runs on the lower half. Connector references in the 1100 series are on the captain side and the 1200 series on the first officer side, and the two are not interchangeable because the pin allocation at the display management control panel differs. Ground studs are shown with their bonding class; a stud shown with class one must be measured after any disturbance.
sections.routing_note: The harnesses leave the panel through the two lower cutouts and run aft along the console side to the avionics bay penetration, supported at 250 millimetre intervals. Neither run may be re-clipped closer than 60 millimetres to the air data control panel bracket, which is a heat source when the panel is dimmed to full bright for long periods.
